capabilities.text: Authenticate nurses via Azure AD Single Sign-On with OAuth 2.0 to ensure verified identities.
Require patient selection before allowing a nurse to save a note, ensuring each note is linked to a patient.
Allow nurses to create and save notes with timestamp, nurse ID, patient ID, and content stored in Azure SQL.
Enable note editing by the original author until the next scheduled sync, after which the note is locked.
Maintain an immutable version history of each note edit, visible to the original author and charge nurses.
Integrate with the hospital’s FHIR-compliant EHR system to pull patient identifiers and bed assignments in real time.
Synchronize notes every 15 minutes to a shared spreadsheet via an Azure Logic App using idempotent API calls to avoid duplicates.
Allow charge nurses to view all ward notes in a consolidated timeline with filtering by patient, nurse, or time range.
Enable charge nurses to flag notes for follow-up by changing status to 'Pending Action' or 'Escalated' and adding supplemental comments.
Restrict clearing of 'Pending Action' or 'Escalated' status to the original note author only, via a dedicated API endpoint.
Allow charge nurses to escalate notes and re-escalate if unresolved after 24 hours, triggering reminders via Azure Logic Apps.
Enforce role-based access control using Azure AD groups to restrict note creation and viewing capabilities appropriately.
Log all write operations, status changes, and escalations with immutable audit trails retained for 180 days.
Encrypt all patient-related data at rest using Azure SQL Transparent Data Encryption and in transit via TLS 1.2+.
Authenticate the backend service to the hospital’s FHIR server using OAuth 2.0 client credentials with secrets stored and rotated in Azure Key Vault.
Provide client-side validation with inline error messages preventing note save without patient selection.
Use Azure Functions to trigger the Logic App sync every 15 minutes and handle retries with exponential backoff on transient failures.
Document all APIs using Swagger (OpenAPI 3.0) for clarity and maintainability.
Provision all infrastructure and resources via Terraform modules with tagging for cost tracking and compliance.
Monitor application health, API calls, and database performance using Azure Monitor and Application Insights with alerting on errors and high resource usage.
